notes.title: New Animations Added – Update for Deal With The Devil: Journey to Tuonela
notes.content:
What’s new in this update:

Improved character animations 

New environmental  details

A couple of new cinematic cutscenes



⚠️ Important Note:

To avoid potential bugs or issues, it is highly recommended to uninstall the previous version of the game before installing this update. Some files may conflict otherwise.
